data.name: Completed full underwriting
data.instructions: Run the Insights journey. Includes two bank accounts, five business systems and at least twelve months of synthetic banking history. Expect one Standard Insights charge.

data.name: Monitoring and reassessment
data.instructions: Run the Signal journey. A pre-approved existing-portfolio baseline and scheduled synthetic source update produce reassessment and an alert. Expect one Standard Signal charge and no Insights charge.

data.name: Insufficient available credits
data.instructions: Submit the Insights request; expect no accepted run or debit. Use portal sandbox funding to restore test credits, then retry the identical key.

data.name: Expired connection authorization
data.instructions: Renew the supplied connection authorization; complete the sandbox hosted flow. Retrieve the same connection ID as active and then sync.

data.name: Rejected evidence
data.instructions: Start underwriting; the sandbox evidence validator rejects the seeded document and returns a rejected requirement with a reason. Upload its replacement from the portal-provided fixture pack using requirement_id; the same run resumes.

data.name: Known workload limit exceeded
data.instructions: Submit the Insights request with over-limit evidence; expect no debit and no automatic tier change.

data.name: Retryable processing failure
data.instructions: Start the run and poll until failure.retryable is true. Retry that same run; its second attempt completes with one total Insights charge.

data.name: Related owner verification
data.instructions: Use an unfinished waiting-for-data business run from the fixture pack and its active association to request person KYC. The included check has no separate charge.

data.name: Duplicate webhook delivery
data.instructions: Register a sandbox receiver; its seeded event is delivered twice with one event ID and fresh signatures. Reconcile attempts and replay using that ID; your consumer must apply the event once.
